motions.name: crouch
motions.prompt: A person crouches down, walks forward under a low overhead obstacle with knees bent, and then stands up.

motions.name: crawl
motions.prompt: A person crawls forward slowly on both hands and knees under a low obstacle, keeping the body close to the ground.

motions.name: ramp
motions.prompt: A person walks slowly uphill on a gentle inclined ramp and stops.

motions.name: bear_walk
motions.prompt: A person bear crawls slowly forward on hands and feet, supporting the body with both hands, keeping knees lifted off the ground.

motions.name: jump_gap
motions.prompt: A person bends both knees and jumps forward across a gap, lands on both feet on the other platform, and stands still.
